verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents API versioning: a REST API versioning page describes a version header that pins responses to a specified version [48], and the APIs are explicitly versioned (Events API v2, V3 webhooks). A webhook migration guide and script hint at a managed upgrade path [77]. However, no documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices, support windows) appears in the evidence. A community report of confusion between v1 and v2 Events API keys points to rough edges in version handling, not a failure of versioning itself. Missing for 10: explicit documented deprecation/sunset policy, deprecation timelines or headers, independent corroboration of smooth version transitions.
